content:
q19.

MemoService is exposed twice off the same `APIV1Service` implementation — the Connect protocol and REST/JSON via grpc-gateway. There is no native gRPC server registration: `RegisterMemoServiceServer` exists only in the generated `proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service_grpc.pb.go:439` and has no call site in the server code.

**Connect (connectrpc) — `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go:40**`
`wrap(apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler(s, opts...))` inside `RegisterConnectHandlers`, mounted on the `http.ServeMux` at line 48. The wrapping type is `ConnectServiceHandler` (`connect_handler.go:21`), which embeds `*APIV1Service` so the gRPC method set satisfies `apiv1connect.MemoServiceHandler` (`proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/memo_service.connect.go:405`); errors are translated by `convertGRPCError` (`connect_handler.go:65`).

**REST/JSON over grpc-gateway — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:108**`
`v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer(ctx, gwMux, s)` registers in-process (no client conn) against the `runtime.NewServeMux` created at `v1.go:96` with the `gatewayAuthMiddleware`, then served under `/api/v1/*` and `/file/*` (`v1.go:128–129`). Generated glue: `proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.gw.go:961`.
